name: DFM1
description: Digitally modelled analog filter with low-pass and high-pass modes. Can be overdriven and self-oscillates at high resonance. Audio code by Tony Hardie-Bick. From sc3-plugins TJUGens.

inputs.name: inputgain
inputs.description: Gain applied to the input before filtering — drives the model into nonlinear territory

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Filter mode: 0.0 for low-pass, 1.0 for high-pass

inputs.name: noiselevel
inputs.description: Amplitude of internal noise added to the model
